issues.body:
Part of #434. Tracking only: these gaps are already explicit in `verification/completeness_gate.json` and `verification/asia_locality_matrix.json`, and they block no release. They close only when a positive source appears, never by silence.

- [ ] **`official-japanese-card-search`** (needs evidence): the official Japanese card search omits categories (the known secret/rainbow gap). Activating it requires pagination fixtures and omission-preserving tests.
- [ ] **`official-asia-cn`** (blocked by source): there is no provider-native Simplified-Chinese card discovery with local identifiers.
- [ ] **`official-korean-historical-positive-frontier`** (needs evidence): the official Korean response accounts for 45 positive identities, but provider-wide historical completeness cannot be claimed.
- [ ] **`official-sea-english-card-discovery`** (needs evidence): no source enumerates English-language products distributed in Southeast Asia. WEST English rows must never be reused for it by language alone.
- [ ] **LATAM Spanish `xJTG`**: an explicit evidence gap in the LATAM slice (see `AGENTS.md`, "Spanish is one language across two localities").

`official-asia-hk-market-provenance` is not listed: the owner decided on 2026-10-30 that HK and TW share the same Traditional-Chinese sets, so that gap is withdrawn.

issues.title: Settle 6 needs-evidence and 4 disputed language units
issues.body:
Part of #434.

## Problem

`verification/evidence_semantics.json` counts 621 units as existing, 88 as owner-adjudicated not printed, and 10 still open.

### Needs evidence (6)

A set-level confirmation does not reach these cards: the card is numbered above the printed set size, or is a promo distributed outside the run. A card-level source is needed.

- [ ] U0169 — s10a 077 V2, Traditional Chinese (Character Rare; 77 above the printed size 71)
- [ ] U0471 — CL 33 V2, Italian (Promo)
- [ ] U0475 — RR 33 V2, Italian (Promo)
- [ ] U0508 — s1H 70 V2, Korean (Rainbow Rare; 70 above 60)
- [ ] U0557 — sm9 115 V3, Korean (Rainbow Rare; 115 above 95)
- [ ] U0601 — s5a 93, Korean (Secret Rare; 93 above 70)

### Disputed (4)

An outside source disagrees with Cardmarket and nothing has settled the question. Under the evidence rules, only an owner adjudication settles an absence. A photograph of the card settles existence.

- [ ] U0265 — sm10 076, Traditional Chinese (Rare)
- [ ] U0414 — sm9 066 V1, Traditional Chinese (Double Rare)
- [ ] U0558 — sm9 115 V3, Traditional Chinese (Rainbow Rare)
- [ ] U0634 — sm9 106 V2, Traditional Chinese (Ultra Rare)

The owner decision of 2026-10-30 that HK and TW share the same Traditional-Chinese sets does not decide these: they concern whether the print exists, not which market it served.

## Done when

Each unit rests on a card-level positive source, or the owner has adjudicated it.

issues.title: Resolve the finish of 10 research placeholders
issues.body:
Part of #434.

## Problem

These local releases are known to exist (card identity established), but no finish is recorded at all (`itemKind = research-placeholder`, finish unit `availabilityStatus = pending`).

- [ ] KR DP 006 Snorlax Lv.X
- [ ] JP XY2 066 Snorlax. The edition is also unresolved: the only catalogue item with `editionAssignmentStatus = unresolved`. XY2 is inside the Japanese 1st-Edition era, so both editions may exist.
- [ ] KR SM-P 017/SM-P Snorlax-GX
- [ ] KR SM-P 140 Eevee & Snorlax-GX (the finish-unresolved row beside the holo row)
- [ ] KR sA 010 Snorlax
- [ ] TW S-P 145 Snorlax
- [ ] KR svI 046 Snorlax
- [ ] ID SVM I 094 Snorlax ex
- [ ] TW M2a F 136 Hop's Snorlax
- [ ] TH MA3 136 Hop's Snorlax

For TW M2a F 136 and TH MA3 136, check first whether the existing finish-unit bridges (`releaseSetCode` overrides, as for ID `MA3 I` → `m2a 136`) already cover them and the placeholder is a leftover duplicate.

## How to resolve

Use a photograph through the manifest importer, or an owner attestation of the finish. Never infer a finish from a language confirmation or from another locality's print.

## Done when

Each placeholder becomes a verified printing with a finish, or is shown to be a duplicate of an existing printing and merged.

issues.title: Confirm or reject 101 marketplace-only finish candidates
issues.body:
Part of #434.

## Problem

101 catalogue items are `finish-candidate` (progress class `research`): the finish rests on a Cardmarket catalogue hint or on an unconfirmed finish flag, with no photographed card showing it. Breakdown: 62 reverse-holo, 29 non-holo, 10 holo.

## How to resolve

- A photograph that shows the card face and its finish (owner specimen, seller photo, Cardmarket seller or product photo) goes through the manifest importer: `python verification/fetch_attachment.py --manifest PATH`.
- An owner finish decision (`finishDecisions` in `owner_adjudications.json`) can close a unit's list or reject a finish the owner knows does not exist (precedents: PCG3 062, SM05, Kisstick).

issues.title: Fill small catalogue identity gaps: DF 10 Italian name, three local set names, EXS image
issues.body:
Part of #434. Each gap needs a positive source; a missing value is not a fact.

## Gaps on main f6d2d2a2

- [ ] **Italian DF 10 Snorlax δ Delta Species**: `localCardName` is empty on both items (reverse-holo verified printing, holo finish candidate). Find the Italian card name from a retained card image and add it to `verification/local_card_names.json`.
- [ ] **Missing `localSetName`** (3 items):
  - [ ] ID Indonesian SM-P 166 Eevee & Snorlax-GX (holo)
  - [ ] TH Thai SM-P 083 Eevee & Snorlax-GX (holo)
  - [ ] KR Korean S-P 101 Snorlax (non-holo)
  Promo releases may have no local set name at all. If the official source names none, record that positively rather than inventing one.
- [ ] **Japanese EXS Snorlax (unnumbered, non-holo)**: one of the two dated EXS items has `imageScope: unknown`. SPEC-0200 (a Cardmarket catalogue scan) exists for EXS. Check whether it belongs to this item or whether another image is needed.

## Done when

Each gap is filled from a retained source, or recorded as positively absent where the source itself prints none. `python scripts/regen.py` passes.
